cost_policy.full_baseline_scope: entire current-correct P, not full DEV_SELECTOR
cost_policy.history_setup: training and full-D f0-f2 inference reported separately, no invented amortization
cost_policy.post_freeze_target_measurement: raw normalized text -> frozen vectorizer.transform -> classifier.predict, 5 repetitions, median, warm-cache order fixed
cost_policy.pre_freeze_probe: all methods and seeds at B=100; must equal main frozen prefixes
cost_policy.reference_probabilities: shared historical f2 cache assumed; extra full-P score reconstruction measured separately, cache construction not free in general
cost_policy.suite_scope: all B=100 suites, including each of 20 stochastic seeds
cost_policy.target_benchmark_execution_count: 5*full_P plus 5*each primary-budget suite; research measurement costs, not deployment savings

hgc_feature_policy.candidate_order: descending w, descending P support, UTF-8 canonical predicate
hgc_feature_policy.conditions: all categorical values, including false; singles and pairs of distinct features
hgc_feature_policy.length: len of NFKC/whitespace-normalized text, including internal spaces
hgc_feature_policy.scope: all DEV_SELECTOR for historical risk; P only for selections and TF-IDF representation

hgc_screen.claim: descriptive practical screen only, not noninferiority or statistical approval
hgc_screen.comparison: per-family mean of per-chain HGC minus ref-margin Recall@100
hgc_screen.cost_scenario: cached history and f2 probabilities, charge pool representation to representation methods; require (selection + representation + selected inference)/full-P inference <= 0.8
hgc_screen.on_failure: report negative/inconclusive; no third tuning round or selecting a new winning configuration

identity_policy.algorithm: canonical inference identity of fitted TF-IDF config/vocabulary/IDF and classifier classes/coef/intercept
identity_policy.claim: absence of exact semantic collision does not imply statistical independence
identity_policy.compare_current_targets_to: all current f0-f2, other current f3, and all 24 previously exposed v1 nodes

limitations: Development-only second round on already used DEV_SELECTOR; never a formal untouched test.
One dataset and one LR architecture; distinct seeds and recipes do not establish independent model families.
DEV halves each miss two labels; recurrent-event support may be zero and must be reported.
Only one HGC configuration; no Risk-LR, Behavior-Anchor, Grad-PD, external dataset, GPU or formal TEST evaluation.
Cost benchmarks use this small CPU task and fixed warm-cache order; not generalizable to neural deployment savings.
No statistical superiority or noninferiority claims; retain every chain, cell, failure and zero denominator.

signal_rule.rationale: 20 events limit one-event Recall change to 0.05; not a statistical power calculation
